gsol 'debs byin rlabs sprin phung bzhugs/oṃ āḥhūm̐/gdod ma'i mgon po kun bzang yab yum la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs

tei:div.tei:p: gsol 'debs byin rlabs sprin phung bzhugs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gdod ma'i mgon po kun bzang yab yum la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// rang byung sems nyid 'od gsal snying po'i don// da lta nyid du rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// lhun grub rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// rang gsal ye shes sgron me gcig po che// da lta nyid du mthong bar byin gyis rlobs// bde chen rgyal po rdo rje 'chang chen la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// 'khor 'das gzhi grol sems nyid chos sku'i don// da lta nyid du rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// ye shes sgyu ma rdo rje sems dpa' la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// mi 'gyur lhun grub bde chen 'og min du// da lta nyid du bgrod par byin gyis rlobs// dkyil 'khor mnga' bdag phyag na rdo rje la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// gsang sngags rgyal po tshe gcig sangs rgyas lam// da lta nyid du phyin par byin gyis rlobs// rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul dga' rab rdo rje la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// gdos bcas phung po ye shes 'od lus su// da lta nyid du grol bar byin gyis rlobs// mkhyen rab sprul pa 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// las dang nyon mongs sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las// da lta nyid du grol bar byin gyis rlobs// blo mchog mnga' ba shrī seng ha la// gsol ba 'debs thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// chos tshul rgya mtsho gsung rabs nor bu'i gling*// da lta nyid du bgrod par byin gyis rlobs// dngos grub mchog brnyes dzñā na su tra la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub yid bzhin gter// da lta nyid du grub par byin gyis rlobs// mkhas grub chen po bi ma mi tra la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// mngon sum 'od gsal snang ba rnam pa bzhi// da lta nyid du 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/

rang byung chen po padma 'byung gnas la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad ma lus pa// da lta nyid du zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ sems nyid dbang thob ting 'dzin bzang po la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ nyin mtshan gnyis med 'od gsal chen po'i ngang*// da lta nyid du 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs// tshogs chen gnyis rdzogs chos rgyal chen po la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// 'phags pa'i nor bdun yon tan rgyal srid mchog /da lta nyid du thob par byin gyis rlobs// thar gling snang mdzad ldang ma lhun rgyal la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// 'gro kun phyam gcig byang chub snying po'i sar// da lta nyid du bgrod par byin gyis rlobs// 'od gsal lhun grub seng ge dbang phyug la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// 'khrul snang zad sar gdod ma'i gzhi dbyings su// da lta nyid du 'jug par byin gyis rlobs// bde chen rgyal po rgyal ba zhang ston la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i don// da lta nyid du rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// gsung rab mdzod 'dzin mkhas pa nyi 'bum la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// ye shes nyi mas ma rig mun pa'i tshogs// da lta nyid du sangs par byin gyis rlobs// dam chos rgyas mdzad gu ru jo 'ber la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// gzhan don rdzogs pa'i phrin las rlabs po che// da lta nyid du grub par byin gyis rlobs// gzung 'dzin 'khrul zhig seng ge rgyab pa la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// 'khor ba'i 'khrul pa tshe 'di'i zhen pa nub// da lta nyid du zad par byin gyis rlobs// dngos grub mchog brnyes grub chen me long la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// don gnyis lhun grub 'od gsal chos nyid ngang*// da lta nyid du phyin par byin gyis rlobs// rig 'dzin chen po ku ma rā dza la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// rtogs pa'i 'od 'bar thugs rje'i sprin dpung mchog

/da lta nyid du 'bar bar byin gyis rlobs// 'od gsal sgyu ma sna tshogs rang grol la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// snang srid snod bcud rmi lam sgyu ma ru// da lta nyid du 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs// bla ma yang tig gi brgyud pa'i kha skong*/ nye brgyud ltar gsol 'debs ni/ grub brgya'i spyi mes 'jigs med gling pa la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// rang byung ye shes gsal 'grib med pa'i don// da lta nyid du rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// snying rje'i dbang phyug rgyal ba'i myu gu la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// tshe 'dir rtse gcig sgrub la brtson pa dang*// gdod ma'i zad sar phyin par byin gyis rlobs// rgyal sras 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// chos brgyad kun rtog 'khrul pa'i bya ba kun// byar med dbyings su zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// gdod ma'i mgon po bstan pa'i nyi ma la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// gsang chen 'od gsal snying po'i gsang lam nas// tshe gcig 'od skur grol bar byin gyis rlobs// bka' drin mtshungs med rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs rnams kyis// don brgyud 'pho ba thob par byin gyis rlobs// ces pa'ang snying tig brgyud pa'i gral mtha' ba sprang bhu su ku snyoms las can col chung mgo yang snang mtho mdo med bstan pa'i bya ba la lhag bsam dkar ba des bri mdog byas pa kun la kha dge bar gyur cig ༄༅// bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa ni/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnyen gcig pu// 'grau ba skyabs med rnams kyi skyabs// thar pa'i lam skas chen po ste// ma rig sel ba'i sgron me la// mun pa'i tshogs bdag skyabs su mchi// 'khor ba 'dam gyi mtsho nang du// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs// dug gsum me yi gdung ba la// rang byung rlabs kyis bsil bar mdzod// ma rig 'khrul pas sgrib pa yi// gdos bcas lus ngag yid rnams kun// rang dngos 'od kyi rang bzhin du// lhag med mya ngan 'da' thob mdzod// bla ma rgyal ba 'gro ba'i mgon// 'gro ba skyob pa'i don brtson pa// stobs chen 'jigs pa kun sel la// de ring nyid nas skyabs su mchi// de yi thugs su chud pa'i chos// 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa sel ba dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la'ang*// de bzhin yang dag skyabs su mchi// bdag ni 'jigs pas rnam skrag nas// kun tu bzang la bdag nyida'abul// 'jam pa'i dbyangs la'ang bdag nyid kyis// bdag gi lus 'di dbul bar bgyi// thugs rje'i spyod pa ma 'khrul ba// spyan ras gzigs mgon de la yang*// nyam thag nga ros 'o dod 'bod// sdig ldan bdag la bskyab du gsol// 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po dang*// sa yi snying po dag dang ni// thugs rje che mgon thams cad la// skyabs 'tshol snying nas 'o dod 'bod// gang zhig mthong nas gshin rje yi// pho nya la sogs sdang ba rnams// skrag nas phyogs bzhir 'byer byed pa// rdo rje can la skyabs su mchi// sngon chad khyed kyi bka' las 'das// da ni 'jigs pa cher mthong nas// khyed la skyabs su mchi lags kyi// 'jigs pa myur du bsal du gsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐/

rig stong zung 'jug gdod ma'i sku// chos sku'i bla ma klong chen pa// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes bzung*// lta ba rtogs bar byin gyis rlobs// gsal stong dbyer med las 'brel rtsal// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes bzung*// sgom pa goms par byin gyis rlobs// sgyu 'phrul rol mo ngag gi dbang*// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes zungs// spyod pa mthar phyin byin gyis rlobs// ngo bo stong pa chos kyi sku// rang bzhin gsal ba longs spyod rdzogs// thugs rje kun khyab sprul pa'i sku// sku gsum bla mar gsol ba 'debs// brgyud gsum bla mas thugs rjes zungs// gsol ba 'debs so rig 'dzin tshogs// byin gyis rlobs shig mkha' 'gro rnams// rig pa rjen pa rnam rtog bral// klong grol yangs pa chen po nyid// myur du rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// ma bcos btang bzhag bral ba'i dbyings// gnyug ma lhun mnyam chen po'i mal// ma bcos sum ldan sgom pa'i klong*// myur du phyin par byin gyis rlobs// chos nyid phyam gdal yangs pa'i klong*// rang grol shar grol cer grol ngang*// gnyen po'i rtsol ba bral ba'i klong*// spyod pa mthar phyin byin gyis rlobs// ye shes dri ma med pa'i dbyings// glo bur mun pa dbyings su yal// ye nas gzhi rdzogs chos sku'i klong*// sku gsum yongs grol byin gyis rlobs// tshul 'di dad pa'i sprin gzhon gyis// bskul ngor nyi mkha' yangs pa'i mkhar// thugs rje bdud rtsi'i sprin phung las// 'dzad med sim byed cung spros so// ༈ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sku// 'pho chen rdo rje'i sku brnyes bi ma la'i// ye shes sgyu ma'i gar mkhan ngag gi dbang*// rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// lam rgyud smin byed dbang gis rgyud smin cing*// bskyed rdzogs lam la brtan pa mthar phyin nas// sems nyid rang bzhin 'od gsal rdzogs pa che'i// gnyug ma'i rang zhal mthong bar byin gyis rlobs// go 'jo bde chen ngor bris pa dge'o//

༈ snying rje'i dbang phyug rgyal ba'i myu gu dang*// o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po'i zhabs// gdod ma'i mgon po bstan pa'i nyi ma dang*// bka' drin mtshungs med rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so gnas lugs rang zhal ston// srid las sogs/ gdul bya'i khams dbang bsam pa bzhin/ ༈ na mo gu ru lo ki shwa ra ya/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus ngo bo bka' drin can/ bla ma spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba 'debs/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ rje btsun bla mas byin gyis rlobs// thugs rje chen pos byin gyis rlobs// spyan ras gzigs kyis byin gyis rlobs// 'gro ba'i mgon pos byin gyis rlobs// 'jig rten dbang pos byin gyis rlobs// rgyal sras mchog gis byin gyis rlobs// yid bzhin nor bus byin gyis rlobs// oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ bdag sogs ma rgan sems can thams cad kyis// ngan sems gdug rtsub zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// bsam sbyor dge bar 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs// nad gdon bar chad zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// sdig sgrib nyes ltung dag par byin gyis rlobs// byang chub sems mchog 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs// rgyal sras spyod la 'jug par byin gyis rlobs// 'brel tshad don dang ldan par byin gyis rlobs// bde chen zhing du skye bar byin gyis rlobs// gzhan don sangs rgyas 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ ༈ mkhyen no mkhyen no gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje mkhyen no// skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi spyi gzugs/ mchog gsum kun 'dus kyi ngo bo/ rtsa gsum kun 'dus kyi mnga' bdag gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje mkhyen no// gsang chen rgyud sde yi ston pa/ mkhas grub rgya mtsho yi gtsug rgyan/

gnas yul mkha' 'gro yi rigs bdag gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje mkhyen no// ka dag chos sku yi ston pa/ lhun grub longs sku yi mnga' bdag thugs rje sku gsum gyi ston pa/ gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje mkhyen no// spangs rtogs mthar phyin gyi sangs rgyas/ lung rtogs dam chos kyi 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyi mnga' bdag gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje mkhyen no// thar pa'i lam ston gyi ded dpon/ ma rig mun sel gyi bla ma/ dag pa'i zhing khams kyi skyel ma/ gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje mkhyen no// sku gsum bka' brgyud kyi ngo bo/ rig 'dzin 'dus pa yi gtsug rgyan/ bka' drin mnyam med kyi bla ma/ gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje mkhyen no// mos gus gdung dbyangs kyi sgra yis/ khyed kyi thugs rje de bskul na/ sngon gyi thugs dam la dgongs nas/ gnas 'dir rdzu 'phrul gyis bskyed la/ ma tshogs mkha' 'gro yi 'khor dang*/ rig 'dzin grub thob dang bcas pas/ gsol 'debs mos pa yi bu la/ byin rlabs char chen de phobs shog snang srid 'od gsal du 'char ba'i/ byin rlabs dngos grub de stsol mdzod/ 'di phyi bar do'i dus thams cad/ 'bral med thugs rje yis zungs la/ bdag gi rigs bdag de mdzod la/ mchog thun dngos grub re stsol shog ces pa 'di bla ma o ṭa'i mtshan can gyis bskul ngor/ sngags btsun las 'brel rtsal gyis bris pa dge'o//
